Leo Park requested temporary Project Harbor staging debugging access to reproduce a provisioning bug, needing it only briefly and not needing commercial or contract material. Security (Priya Rao) approved logs-only Project Harbor staging debugging access for Leo through Friday 19:00 as a scoped window, not standing broad access. Leo Park acknowledged that the window is logs-only through Friday 19:00 and does not expand into customer or contract access. As of Priya Rao's later report, Leo's temporary debugging window for Project Harbor was still active, remaining logs-only and time-bounded. As of Priya Rao's latest report, Leo's temporary Project Harbor debugging access is now revoked; the repro window has closed, and Leo should no longer be treated as an active accessor on the incident.
